name: librewolf
summary: [LibreWolf](https://librewolf.net/) is a custom and independent version of Firefox, with the primary goals of privacy, security and user freedom. LibreWolf also aims to remove all the telemetry, data collection and annoyances, as well as disabling anti-freedom features like DRM.

ports.description: LibreWolf desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

volumes.description: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

env.name: LIBREWOLF_CLI
env.description: Specify one or multiple LibreWolf CLI flags, this string will be passed to the application in full.

custom.description: This is needed for any modern website to function like youtube.

docs.setup:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/
